decision_basis: 32 complete official development cells and literature boundary review before held-out outcomes
rationale: All 16 matched task/model pairs failed binary resolution in both S0 and S1; three S1 cells accessed a main Skill body without completing the task, while most showed no observed content access. The observed failures are heterogeneous. Candidate routing, compression, executable-interface and path-repair mechanisms overlap prior published methods, and no literature-distinct, faithful and fair S2 was validated on development official resolution. Adding one now would turn an unvalidated idea or task-specific repair into a formal condition.
